## Problem
Supplier payments and claim settlements are being held up due to system delays in processing, reserves management, and task visibility. This causes financial disruptions and erodes supplier trust.

## Who is affected
- Eight accounts have raised this issue [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:45301fb117b39eed][i:5585b9709f395142][i:6b7c8ed2329abf7f][i:6d3745cd75536ec4][i:93b8e761e9cceaa4][i:b7380b00be1f3ce1][i:be735de1d3abf12d].
- The feedback has come through three routes: five mentions from sales, two from support, and one from account management [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:45301fb117b39eed][i:5585b9709f395142][i:6b7c8ed2329abf7f][i:93b8e761e9cceaa4][i:6d3745cd75536ec4][i:be735de1d3abf12d][i:b7380b00be1f3ce1].
- The affected accounts represent a total ARR of 4,750,000 GBP [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:45301fb117b39eed][i:5585b9709f395142][i:6b7c8ed2329abf7f][i:6d3745cd75536ec4][i:93b8e761e9cceaa4][i:b7380b00be1f3ce1][i:be735de1d3abf12d].

## Evidence
- Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reported that "We’re still seeing some delays with the webhook retries on our supplier payments module, and it’s causing issues with how we process claims and update policyholders in real time" [i:23d386fc82d6c342].
- Holloway Reach Underwriting stated, "Exactly. It’s not just inconvenient — it’s holding up payments and supplier invoices too" [i:45301fb117b39eed].
- Marrowgate Commercial said, "We’ve been reviewing how claims and documents flow through our current system, and it’s causing delays in reserves and payments" [i:5585b9709f395142].
- Sallowmere Motor noted, "Also, our finance team needs clearer reporting on reserves versus actual payments — it’s ... causing delays in supplier reconciliation" [i:6b7c8ed2329abf7f].
- Penhallow Specialty Risks explained that "we rely on those tasks being visible to avoid delays with supplier payments" [i:6d3745cd75536ec4].
- Stannary Commercial said, "I think we need a clearer way to manage reserves and supplier payments" [i:93b8e761e9cceaa4].
- Pendleford Motor Mutual stated, "Appreciate that — we need to avoid any more delays in payments or supplier settlements" [i:b7380b00be1f3ce1].
- Callowfield Auto Assurance reported that "it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions" [i:be735de1d3abf12d].

## Why now
- Two accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days [i:5585b9709f395142][i:93b8e761e9cceaa4].
- The issue has been raised consistently from September to October 2026 [i:6d3745cd75536ec4][i:93b8e761e9cceaa4][i:b7380b00be1f3ce1][i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:45301fb117b39eed][i:5585b9709f395142][i:6b7c8ed2329abf7f][i:be735de1d3abf12d].
- The financial impact is significant, with affected accounts including Marrowgate Commercial (ARR 1,600,000 GBP), Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR 1,250,000 GBP), and Pendleford Motor Mutual (ARR 690,000 GBP) [i:5585b9709f395142][i:be735de1d3abf12d][i:b7380b00be1f3ce1].
</previous_draft>

{

## Who is affected
